properties.evidence: Not duplicates — the earlier fact predicted the later one and named the mechanism six days early. On 2026-08-23 it recorded that a reporter running a pre-#303 binary filed an already-fixed defect, and then wrote 'THE SAME TRAP IS LIVE ON THIS SIDE', naming the stale shared server explicitly. On 2026-08-29 Alex hit exactly that: an upgraded disk binary at 0.42.0 with a daemon from 14:58 still serving 0.39.0. The 2026-08-23 fact is about an agent that cannot NAME its version and so misreports; the 2026-08-29 fact is about the upgrade path that LEAVES it on the old one. Distinct claims, and the first anticipates the second.
